jab sooraj lapet diya jaye ga ,
aur jab sitaray toot toot ker giren gay ,
aur jab paharon ko chalaya jaye ga ,
aur jab das maheenay ki gabahan oontniyon ko bhi beykaar chorr diya jaye ga ,
aur jab wehshi janwer ikatthay kerdiye jayen gay ,
aur jab samandaron ko bharkaya jaye ga ,
aur jab logon  kay jooray jooray bana diye jayen gay ,
aur jiss bachi ko zinda qabar mein gaarr diya gaya tha , jab uss say poocha jaye ga
kay ussay kiss jurm mein qatal kiya gaya-?
aur jab aemal namay khol diye jayen gay ,
aur jab aasman ka chilka utaar diya jaye ga ,
aur jab dozakh bharkai jaye gi ,
aur jab jannat qareeb kerdi jaye gi ,
to uss waqt her shaks ko apna sara kiya dhara maloom hojaye ga .
abb mein qasam khata hun unn sitaron ki jo peechay ki taraf chalney lagtay hain ,
jo chaltay chaltay dubuk jatay hain ,
aur qasam khata hun raat ki jab woh rukhsat ho ,
aur subha ki jab woh saans ley ,
kay yeh ( Quran ) yaqeeni tor per aik moaziz farishtay ka laya huwa kalam hai ,
jo quooat wala hai , jiss ka arsh walay kay paas bara rutba hai .
wahan uss ki baat maani jati hai   woh amanat daar hai .
aur ( aey makkah walo ! ) tumharay sath rehney walay yeh sahab ( yani hazrat Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) koi deewaney nahi hain ,
aur yeh bilkul sachi baat hai kay unhon ney iss farishtay ko khulay huye ufaq per dekha hai ,
aur woh ghaib ki baaton kay baaray mein bakheel bhi nahi hain .
aur naa yeh ( Quran ) kissi mardood shetan ki ( banai hoi ) koi baat hai .
phir bhi tum log kidhar chalay jarahey ho-?
yeh to duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik naseehat hai ,
. tum mein say her uss shaks kay liye jo seedha seedha rehna chahye !
aur tum chahao gay nahi , illa yeh kay khud Allah chahye jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
